title: Simplify shopkeeper login flow after admin approval

requirements.summary: Automatically enable shop functionality immediately after admin approval without requiring additional login steps or permission checks
acceptanceCriteria: When admin approves a shop registration, the shopkeeper can immediately access their dashboard without re-authenticating
Shopkeeper users see their shop status update in real-time or after a single page refresh
No additional permission prompts or loading states block shopkeeper access after approval
The shop dashboard page (ShopDashboardPage) detects approval status and displays shop management controls without requiring logout/login

file_operations.description: Remove any barriers that require shopkeepers to log out and back in after admin approval. Ensure the page automatically detects when a shop transitions from pending to approved status and immediately displays shop management controls (toggle online/offline). Add polling or real-time check to detect approval status changes without requiring manual refresh.

Remove authentication barriers that block approved shopkeepers from accessing inventory management. Ensure the page checks current shop approval status from the user profile and immediately grants access to product management when the shop is approved, without requiring re-login.
Ensure approved shopkeepers can immediately access their orders page without additional permission checks or login prompts. Verify the page uses current shop status from user profile query.
Remove any permission gates that prevent approved shopkeepers from viewing their sales ledger. Ensure the page checks current approval status and grants immediate access when approved.

requirements.summary: Add automatic query invalidation and refetch when shop approval status changes so shopkeepers see updated permissions without manual refresh
acceptanceCriteria: When an admin approves a shop, all active shopkeeper sessions automatically refetch user profile and shop data
Shopkeeper UI transitions from 'pending approval' to 'active shop' state without requiring page reload
React Query cache invalidation triggers when shop status changes from pending to approved

file_operations.description: Add a polling mechanism or optimistic update logic to the useGetCallerUserProfile hook to automatically refetch user profile data at regular intervals (e.g., every 5-10 seconds) when a shopkeeper is in pending approval state. When the profile indicates shop approval, invalidate related queries (shops, products) to trigger UI updates. Ensure mutation hooks for shop approval (useApproveShop) invalidate the currentUserProfile query key to trigger immediate refetch for affected shopkeepers.

Implement UI state transitions that respond to user profile changes. When the useGetCallerUserProfile hook detects a shop has been approved (approved: true), automatically update the displayed UI from 'pending approval' state to 'active shop' controls without requiring page reload. Consider using React Query's onSuccess callback or useEffect to detect approval status changes.

Create a custom hook that implements polling logic for shopkeepers with pending shop approval. The hook should use useGetCallerUserProfile with refetchInterval when the shop exists but is not yet approved. Once approval is detected, stop polling and invalidate related query keys (currentUserProfile, shops) to trigger UI updates across all shopkeeper pages.

requirements.summary: Remove unnecessary authentication barriers or complex permission checks that prevent shopkeepers from accessing their dashboard after initial Internet Identity login and admin approval
acceptanceCriteria: Shopkeeper role users only need to authenticate once with Internet Identity
After shop approval, no additional login prompts or permission gates block access to inventory, orders, or ledger pages
The RoleGuard component correctly identifies approved shopkeepers and grants immediate access to shopkeeper routes

file_operations.description: Simplify the RoleGuard logic to ensure shopkeepers with approved shops are granted immediate access to shopkeeper routes without additional permission checks. Verify the component uses the current user profile from useGetCallerUserProfile and checks both appRole and shop approval status. Remove any redundant authentication prompts or loading states that block access after the initial Internet Identity login.

Remove complex permission checks or conditional logic that creates additional barriers to accessing inventory management. Ensure the page relies solely on RoleGuard and shop approval status from the user profile, without implementing duplicate authentication checks that might require re-login.

Review route definitions for shopkeeper pages (/shopkeeper/dashboard, /shopkeeper/inventory, /shopkeeper/orders, /shopkeeper/ledger) and ensure they use RoleGuard correctly with allowedRoles=['shopkeeper']. Verify that no additional authentication middleware or guards are applied that would create unnecessary login barriers for approved shopkeepers.

Ensure the useAuth hook provides a stable and consistent authentication state that prevents unnecessary re-authentication prompts. Verify that the hook correctly combines Internet Identity state and user profile data without introducing race conditions or loading states that could block shopkeeper access after approval.
